p: bill of your mother's divorcement: Meaning, that he has not forsaken her, but through her own opportunity as in Ho 2:2.
whom I have put away: Who would declare that I have cut her off: meaning, that they could show no one.
to whom I have sold you: Signifying, that he sold them not for any debt or poverty, but that they sold themselves to sins to buy their own lusts and pleasures.
Why: He came by his prophets and ministers, but they would not believe their doctrine and convert.
shortened at all: Am I not able to help you, as I have helped your fathers of old, when I dried up the Red sea, and killed the fish in the rivers, and also afterward in Jordan?
sackcloth their covering: As I did in Egypt in token of my displeasure, Ex 10:21.
me the tongue of the learned: The prophet represents here the person and charge of them that are justly called to the ministry by God's word.
weary: To him that is oppressed by affliction and misery.
as the learned: As they who are taught, and made meet by him.

smiters: I did not shrink from God for any persecution or calamity. By which he shows that the true ministers of God can look for no other recompense of the wicked, but after this sort, and also that is their comfort.
Who is among you that feareth: Showing that it is a rare thing that any should obey correctly God's true ministers, though they labour to bring them from hell to heaven.
a fire: You have sought consolation by your own devises, and have refused the light and consolation which God has offered: therefore you will remain in sorrow and not be comforted.
